subject: Planned data deletion completed
heading: Planned data deletion completed
body: Cockpit Context permanently deleted data it no longer uses. This was scheduled when the database layout changed and ran after the waiting period. Nothing went wrong, and no action is required.
effectsFallback: Data marked for removal in the database change.
recovery: If you need this data back, ask your app maintainer to copy only the data you need from this backup. Restoring the whole backup would also undo changes made since then.
noBackup: No backup was taken immediately before deletion. Ask your app maintainer about other recovery options and setting up backups.
